elements.text: Weather information is spread across forecast applications, technical dashboards, map services and separate emergency-alert platforms. Users often need to interpret numerical data without receiving a clear explanation of how the conditions affect their location, activity or travel plans. Most applications provide static results and require manual navigation between screens. Weather GPT addresses this gap through an agentic AI assistant that understands user intent, selects trusted weather and alert sources, analyses the retrieved information and presents relevant guidance through text, voice and interactive maps.
